body.message:
Arcanna Inference Results


  • Event ID: @{body('Get_Decision')?['event_id']}
  • Pipeline ID: @{body('Send_Event')?['job_id']}
  • Ingest Timestamp: @{body('Get_Decision')?['ingest_timestamp']}
  • Status: @{body('Get_Decision')?['status']}
  • Result: @{body('Get_Decision')?['result']}
  • Result Label: @{body('Get_Decision')?['result_label']}
  • Bucket State: @{body('Get_Decision')?['bucket_state']}
  • Knowledge Base State: @{body('Get_Decision')?['knowledge_base_state']}
  • Outlier: @{body('Get_Decision')?['outlier']}
  • Confidence Score: @{body('Get_Decision')?['confidence_score']}%

Arcanna Processing Error

  • Event ID: @{body('Get_Decision')?['event_id']}
  • Status: @{body('Get_Decision')?['status']}
  • Result: @{body('Get_Decision')?['result_label']}
  • Error Message: @{body('Get_Decision')?['error_message']}

Please check with your Arcanna administrator.

metadata.title: Arcanna - Triage Microsoft Sentinel incidents
metadata.description: Submits newly created Microsoft Sentinel incidents to Arcanna, polls for the Arcanna decision, and writes the result back to the incident.
prerequisites: Deploy the Arcanna Custom Azure Logic Apps Connector first: https://portal.azure.com/#create/Microsoft.Template/uri/https%3A%2F%2Fraw.githubusercontent.com%2Fsiscale%2Farcanna-microsoft-sentinel%2Ffeature%2Fguid-event-id-pipeline-tag%2FArcannaConnector%2Fazuredeploy.json
Have an Arcanna API key assigned to an Arcanna integration.
Know the Arcanna Pipeline ID that new incidents should be sent to by default.
postDeployment: Authorize the Arcanna API connection if Azure requests authorization.
Grant Microsoft Sentinel permission to run playbooks in this playbook resource group from Playbook permissions.
Verify the Arcanna - Triage new incidents automation rule is enabled.

releaseNotes.title: Incident GUID event IDs and pipeline tag

properties.descriptionHtml:
Note: Please refer to the following before installing the solution:

• Review the solution Release Notes

• There may be known issues pertaining to this Solution, please refer to them before installing.

The Arcanna solution for Microsoft Sentinel provides AI-assisted incident triage and analyst feedback workflows. It includes an Arcanna Custom Azure Logic Apps Connector plus playbook templates for submitting Sentinel incidents to Arcanna, polling for decisions, writing results back to incidents, and returning analyst closure feedback to Arcanna.

Custom Azure Logic Apps Connectors: 1, Playbooks: 2

Learn more about Microsoft Sentinel | Learn more about Solutions
